title: Tomato Soup with Grilled Cheese Sandwich
summary: A classic American lunch of smooth, savory tomato soup paired with a crisp, buttery grilled cheese sandwich. Comforting, quick to make, and best served hot with plenty of melted cheese.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until soft and translucent.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in the canned tomatoes, vegetable stock, sugar, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes.
Blend the soup until smooth, then return it to the pan and keep warm. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Spread butter on one side of each bread slice. Place two slices butter-side down and top with the cheddar. Close with the remaining bread slices, butter-side up.
Cook the sandwiches in a dry skillet over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, pressing gently, until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Serve the tomato soup hot with the grilled cheese sandwiches on the side or cut into halves for dipping.
